toolsPreview.name: list_niches
toolsPreview.description: List the collectible niches the Drop Index covers. Use to pick a valid 'niche' value.

toolsPreview.name: drop_index
toolsPreview.description: Return the live restock index for a niche: which tracked items are restocking now, recently dropped, or low stock, across the indie shops we poll. Use to see real-time availability signals. niche must be one of: tcg, lego, funko, keebs, vinyl, aqua.

toolsPreview.name: will_it_restock
toolsPreview.description: Predict whether a specific item will restock: returns any accrued restock-cadence stats, a probability, and a WAIT (likely to restock) vs BUY-RESALE verdict — or an honest 'no history yet'. Use before paying a resale premium.
